proposals.title: Special Shareholder Meeting Improvement
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend governing documents so owners of a combined 10% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareholder meeting, lowering the current 25% threshold.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Board Chair to be an independent director, with a non-independent non-CEO director as interim chair if none is available.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Requesting a Public Report on the Use of Concealment Clauses
proposals.topic_summary: Asks for a public report assessing risks to the company from using concealment clauses in employment agreements related to harassment, discrimination and unlawful acts.
proposals.evidence: THEREFORE, THE BOARD RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.
